title.value: Precision, Equity, and Public Health and Epidemiology Informatics – A Scoping Review
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning and throughout the paper.
title.quote: Precision, Equity, and Public Health and Epidemiology Informatics – A Scoping Review

analysis.description: This scoping review synthesizes recent literature on precision public health and the influence of predictive models on health equity, highlighting central concepts and identifying research opportunities for the biomedical informatics community.

type.justification: The paper conducts a scoping review, which involves searching and collating existing studies, thus it follows an empirical methodology.
type.quote: This scoping review synthesizes the recent literature on precision public health and the influence of predictive models on health equity.

name.justification: The paper focuses on using predictive models and precision approaches in public health and epidemiology, which aligns with this field.
name.quote: Precision public health and the influence of predictive models on health equity are two topics that have received considerable attention recently.

name.justification: The paper discusses the equity implications and biases of prediction models informed by machine learning.
name.quote: In the context of the recent renaissance of machine learning, and particularly deep neural networks and reinforcement learning, the potential for prediction models in clinical medicine and public health to exacerbate health inequities is increasingly recognized.

aliases: Bias and Fairness in Machine Learning
